info.title: Freedcamp Public API
info.description:
OpenAPI specification for the Freedcamp public REST API, derived from the
official API wiki.

## Authentication

Three credential styles are supported (see `securitySchemes`):

- **Not-secured API key** — pass `api_key` as a query or POST parameter.
  Expires one week after creation.
- **Secured API key** — pass `api_key` together with `timestamp`
  (request UNIX timestamp) and `hash`, where:

  ```
  hash = hash_hmac('sha1', api_key . timestamp, api_secret)
  ```

  When using a secured key, add the reusable `timestamp` and `hash`
  query parameters to the request.
- **Header key** — pass the key via the `X-API-KEY` header instead of in
  the URL or body. (Used by the Postman collection.)

A session token may also be passed via the `X-API-TOKEN` header.

## Requests

Non-GET requests pass their (non-auth) parameters as a raw JSON body with
`Content-Type: application/json`. A legacy form-data style (a `data` field
holding a JSON-encoded string) is also still supported. "Update" (EDIT)
requests use POST and include the id of the modified item in the path.

## Responses

Every response is a JSON object with `http_code`, `msg`, `error_id`,
an optional `maintenance` block, and a request-specific `data` object.
Validation errors are returned under `data.errors`.

## Notes / wiki ambiguities preserved

- `/validations` GET: the wiki documents the path as `/notifications/email`
  while the section header is `/validations`; modelled here as
  `/validations/email`.
- `/lists` EDIT/DELETE paths are modelled as `/lists/{app_id}/{list_id}`.
- Endpoints marked "not allowed publicly" / "not supported now" in the wiki
  are included and flagged with `deprecated: true` and a description note.


This combined specification merges the wiki-derived reference (authoritative schemas, parameters, and descriptions) with concrete request examples taken from the official Postman collection.

get.description: Returns current session info (same data as the ADD request, minus the token).

post.description:
WARNING: not supported now. Returns a session token plus initial-screen
info for valid credentials. `X-API-TOKEN` should be empty.

delete.description: WARNING: not supported now. Closes the current session and invalidates the token.

admins.description: User ids to set as group admins.
Updatable only by the group owner.

f_active.description: If present, archives (false) or unarchives (true) all projects in the group instead of editing group fields.

delete.description: Only the group owner can delete a group.

post.summary: Add users or global teams to a group
post.description: Requires manage permission on the group. Provide either `users` or `invited_global_teams`.

delete.description: Removes the current user from the group. Cannot be the group owner or an Account Admin.

delete.summary: Remove a user from a group
Remove a global team from a group

post.summary: Manage a user's group membership globally

delete.summary: Remove a user from all groups

parameters.name: f_recent_projects_ids
parameters.description: If 1, also returns `recent_project_ids`. Avoid calling more than once an hour.

get.description:
Like `/projects` but the `projects` array holds only the specified project,
with extra fields: `notifications`, `f_subtasks_adv`, `f_can_add_tasks`.
Ordered most-recently-visited first. Avoid calling more than once an hour.

post.summary: Add/remove a user across multiple projects

delete.description: Removes the current user from the project. Cannot be the project owner or a Group Admin.

delete.summary: Remove a global team from a project

parameters.name: container_id
parameters.description: project_id or group_id depending on module type.

post.description: WARNING: not allowed publicly for now.

delete.description: WARNING: not allowed publicly for now.

post.description: Same fields as create; pass only changed parameters.

post.summary: Add users, groups or projects to a team

parameters.name: f_dry_run
parameters.description: 1 to preview without applying (default). Pass 0 to apply.

parameters.name: f_set
parameters.description: 1 to replace the entire list instead of adding to it.

delete.summary: Remove a user from a team

post.description:
`X-API-TOKEN` should be empty. To include an avatar, use multipart/form-data
(a `data` JSON field plus an `avatar` file field).

Changing email or password requires `confirmation_password` and logs the
user out of all devices; a new `token` is returned and must replace the old one.

get.description: WARNING: not allowed publicly for now. Returns `f_password_needed`.

post.description: WARNING: not allowed publicly for now. Deletes the account and all linked data.

post.summary: Set a new password using a reset key

post.description: Send the avatar as a form `file` field (not inside JSON `data`).

get.description: Disabled by default; contact support to enable. Can be slow.

Checks that an email is valid and not already in the project; returns an
avatar URL on success. (Wiki documents this under `/notifications/email`.)

post.description:
Edit up to 500 tasks at once. Only passed fields are updated.
The followers operation is mutually exclusive with field edits.

post.summary: Edit a time record or run an action
post.description:
With a non-empty `action`, runs the action (start/stop/bill/unbill).
Otherwise updates properties.

get.description: Default period is the current month; override with `from_ts`/`to_ts`.

f_new_version.description: true saves the change as a new version snapshot.

app_id.description: Supported apps - APP_TODOS, APP_FILES, APP_DISCUSSIONS, APP_BUGTRACKER, APP_WIKI, APP_CALENDAR.

post.description: Send a `data` JSON field plus a `file` binary field as multipart/form-data.

data.description:
JSON with application_id (required), project_id, item_id,
comment_id, temporary.

get.description: With `project_id`, lists for that project. Without it (Tasks only), lists across all projects.

h_parent_id.description: APP_FILES only - parent folder id for subfolders.

delete.description: WARNING: not allowed publicly for now.

post.description: Keys are target app_ids; values are arrays of item ids in that app.

delete.summary: Delete a custom field template (NOT public)
delete.description: WARNING: not allowed publicly for now.

get.description: Ordered by date created DESC. Use a reasonable limit.

post.summary: Create a CRM contact or lead
Convert a lead to a contact

ApiKeyQuery.name: api_key
ApiKeyQuery.description:
Pass your API key as the `api_key` query parameter. For secured keys,
also add `timestamp` and `hash` query parameters (see info description).

Timestamp.name: timestamp
Timestamp.description: Request UNIX timestamp. Required for secured API keys.

Hash.name: hash
Hash.description: HMAC-SHA1 of (api_key + timestamp) keyed by api_secret. Required for secured API keys.

FollowingQuery.name: following
FollowingQuery.description: 1 to return only items the user follows.

AppIdPath.name: app_id
AppIdPath.description: Integer application id (e.g. 2 Tasks, 6 Files, 3 Discussions, 14 Wiki, PassMan).

http_code.description: Duplicates the HTTP code in the headers.

msg.description: 'OK' on success, an error description otherwise.

data.description: Request-specific data. On error, validation errors are under `data.errors`.

email.description: null if the requester lacks permission to see it.

url.description: Authorized S3 URL, expires in 24 hours.

dd_actual_value.description: For dropdown fields, the resolved value.
